name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B Email Marketing & HubSpot Automation Specialist
summary: B2B marketing professional with 15+ years of experience and hands-on HubSpot fluency built across three roles - Level Agency, Fetch & Funnel, and Senior Directory. Specializes in email campaigns, automated lead-nurturing workflows, and content creation that moves prospects through the funnel, backed by rigorous performance tracking and analysis. Comfortable working close to the tools day to day: building the workflow, writing the copy, and reading the results.

Architected a complete marketing-automation system - 20+ workflows spanning lead capture/tagging, qualification, appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, long-term nurture/reactivation, and automated review-generation sequences.
Built segmented email and outreach campaigns (website-visibility, missed-calls, and low-reviews) plus an automated audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts based on scored engagement signals.
Draft clean, specific, ethically aligned direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive engagement and pipeline.
Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides on systems architecture, CRM optimization, and operational growth for B2B audiences.
Track acquisition and retention using GA4 and CRM analytics, delivering reporting that drives experimentation and growth.
Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor research, implementing fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across marketing and operations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced high-converting campaign assets - landing pages, complex email sequences, conversion-focused copy - improving lead generation and pipeline.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.

Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and strengthened cross-team alignment.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.

Built the outreach, qualification, and pipeline fundamentals that carried into later B2B marketing and sales roles.
